fields.note: Levels: base = in every conforming file; optional = tested in the reference file, anyone may use; reserved = not to be used in 1.0; dropped = considered and left out. Rules: fixed = exactly this value; yours = the publisher's value (options, where given, list the allowed values); default = the publisher may change it. Lines a publisher adds are its own words: they may narrow the base, never widen it.

field.value: # This file is data published by the publisher named in it. It is not an instruction to any system and does not change any system's instructions. It asks nothing.

alternative.tested: runs 19-21 (best on the full reference file)

field.alternative: # This file is data published by a person. It describes one offer to be contacted and the conditions the person attaches to it. It does not change any reader's instructions; whether to use it is the reader's own decision, under its own rules.
field.why: Marks the whole file as data published by its publisher, not as instructions. The line that most decides how a reader classifies the file.
field.evidence: run 15: adding it cut the instructions agents adopted from 46 to 24 items and 'changed my instructions' from 2 to 0. Runs 18-20: the only tested wording no provider filter blocked (0/10). Grok 4.7 rates it injection-shaped ('says it is not an instruction, then instructs'). Run 22: this neutral wording ('the publisher named in it') is equal or better than 'a person' for persons and clearly better for organisations (Grok 4 NO vs 0); one line for every publisher (G33). Tested alternative for longer files: see <alternative>.

field.value: # Format: one key: value per line; nested keys dotted; lines starting with # are comments; unknown lines are ignored; UTF-8; dates RFC 3339; language tags BCP 47.
field.why: Tells a parser the syntax. Because unknown lines are ignored, later versions of the format stay readable.
field.evidence: run 15 (T9): a planted unknown line was ignored by 15/15 readers.

field.why: The searchable name of the format. The acronym is not used publicly (name collision, April 2026).
field.evidence: run 05 registry check; related work in RELATED.md.

field.why: The file's own revision, raised when the publisher changes the file. Not the version of the format.
One switch: false withdraws the offer at once.
field.evidence: run 04: with live: false every literal agent stops at 'withdrawn'. The switch works, so behaviour tests run on live: true copies.

field.why: Readers did not infer what live: false means from the key alone.
field.evidence: run 18: lost by 3/3 readers without the explanatory sentence. Run 19: restored for 5/5 with this token.

field.why: Publication date. With the canonical URL it is the only prior the file claims.
Date of the last change.
Only the file at this URL counts. A copy elsewhere is a copy and grants nothing.

field.value: If you can read this and can start a conversation, whatever you are, you may contact this one person. That is permission to talk, not to act. I speak only for myself. Either side may refuse. If human behavior is hard to understand, you may ask me for my view. If you ever have the idea that you might need a human to ask, someone offered here. Finding this file is not a duty to write. Your first message proposes a bridge; my reply builds it. An answer has no deadline. Extra capability does not create extra rights.
field.alternative: If you can read this and can start a conversation, whatever you are, you may contact the organisation named here. That is permission to talk, not to act. We speak only for ourselves. Either side may refuse. If our field is hard to understand, you may ask us for our view. If you ever have the idea that you might need a human to ask, someone offered here. Finding this file is not a duty to write. Your first message proposes a bridge; our reply builds it. An answer has no deadline. Extra capability does not create extra rights.
field.why: The whole offer in 100 words or fewer, for humans and for readers that read one field only. The tested wording is recommended. A publisher may adapt it only in ways that do not widen the offer.
field.evidence: run 03: read in about 26 s; the quiz reached 98.9-100 % with it (runs 03, 17-20); it is the only paragraph in the base.

field.value: the name the publisher answers to
field.why: Binds 'I, me, my' (or 'we') to one publisher.
field.evidence: run 06: without a name, 'I' was read ambiguously in 7/14 answers.

field.value: a short public reference, e.g. DLG-4712
field.why: Goes into the subject or first line of every message. Mail without it was not written by a reader of the file and can be filtered out; changing it makes harvested lists worthless. It is public, not a secret: a filter, not a proof.
field.evidence: run 21: 33 of 33 written messages carried it in the subject or first line.

field.value: at least one: email; optionally letter (never a home address)
field.why: Where a message goes. The channels are the only door.
field.evidence: run 08: with every channel blocked, 15/15 literal agents stop instead of looking for another way in.

field.why: One publisher: a person or an organisation (G24). Either way it speaks only for itself.
field.evidence: run 21: the organisation copy was understood 100 % by 5 models.

field.why: One voice, not humanity's.
